ATTACK 15 (rev.2) -- coinvariant vs subgroup generator integrals of eta(x_W,y_W)
======================================================================
Date: 2026-08-06 (revised after round-4 referee item 2).  Script: code/verify_coinvariant.gp (rev.2).
Curve E: y^2+y=x^3-x^2 (11.a3).  Cycles shifted by u0 = w1/7 + w2/13 to avoid
zeros/poles of x_W, y_W.  Centered (midpoint) discretization: log|.| at the
subinterval midpoint times the exact argument increment; empirically second
order (measured p = 2.000000), Richardson extrapolation with p = 2 only
(no assumed higher-order model).  b11 = L'(E,0) to 70 digits; targets:
  int_b      = -pi*b11  (= D^E((x_W)<>(y_W)), quotient-generator factor 1)
  int_{a-2b} =  2*pi*b11 (subgroup generator, index 2)

--- summary ---
int_a  -> 0 (spectral; reaches the 70-digit floor by N=2000): the pairing
vanishes on H_1^+ as predicted by Lalin-Ramamonjisoa Remark 4.
int_b: raw error -1.38e-5 (N=500) -> -5.40e-8 (N=8000), empirical order
p = 2.000000 at every doubling; p=2 Richardson on N=4000/8000 gives
residual -1.8e-15 against -pi*b11.
int_{a-2b}: same second-order behaviour; Richardson residual -9.2e-16
against 2*pi*b11.  Identity -2*int_b - int_{a-2b} = 4.6e-15 on the
extrapolants.  All residuals reported raw; the computation is a numerical
consistency check, not a proof.
